note: Where every NASA picture in data/nasa/ comes from, and the live NASA service the page can ask for finer pictures. The About & sources dialog of the page is built from this file. Entries in files with fetch=true can be downloaded again with scripts/fetch_nasa_data.py. NASA does not endorse this project.

files.role: The map picture that opens with the page (also copied inside index.html as base64). Values are read from it.
files.note: Equirectangular, 1024 x 512, no date stamp. It was the most recent frame when downloaded; its date was found by comparing it with the EXR frames of 9, 10 and 11 November 2026.
files.dataset: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Anomaly - Near Real Time
files.underlying_data: JPL MUR SST analysis (Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution Sea Surface Temperature), PO.DAAC; SVS dataset ID 845

files.role: NASA's colour bar (-4 to +4 degrees C). The colour table in index.html was read from it.
files.note: A colour scale, not a map of one day.
files.dataset: Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Anomaly - Near Real Time
files.underlying_data: JPL MUR SST analysis (Multi-scale Ultra-high Resolution Sea Surface Temperature), PO.DAAC; SVS dataset ID 845

files.role: One picture of the time slider.
files.processing: NASA publishes this frame only as a 4096 x 2048 EXR file (the url). It was reduced to 1024 x 512 (average of 4 x 4 pixels), converted to 8-bit colour with the sRGB curve and saved as a JPEG (quality 90). The url is the original, not this file.

files.role: Wildlife diversity sound layer: the number of mammal species (all species, land and sea mammals) in each cell. Values are read from it with the GIBS colour table (mammals/Mammal_Richness_Grids_All_Species_2013.xml).
files.note: 2048 x 1024, equirectangular (-180..180, -90..90), PNG in GIBS colours (one class for every number of species from 1 to 203). The data are a 2013 picture (IUCN data downloaded in April 2013; the date here is that month). Mammals only, no birds. The picture also covers the oceans (marine mammals); the page uses it on land only. GIBS reduced it from 30 arc-second cells, so each pixel is one cell, not an average.
files.attribution: NASA SEDAC (CIESIN, Columbia University and NatureServe) through NASA GIBS

Gridded Species Distribution: Global Mammal Richness Grids, 2015 Release (Version 2015.00) [Data set]. Palisades, NY: NASA Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center (SEDAC). https://doi.org/10.7927/H4N014G5
files.terms_note: NASA Earthdata states that the dataset is openly shared without restriction (EOSDIS Data Use and Citation Guidance). The picture is built from IUCN Red List ranges; whether IUCN's own terms add a condition for copies of this derived picture was not checked at the SEDAC page (the page could not be opened from the build computer). Check it before the copy is shared more widely.
